svg.text: Six phases, three tracks — and the lanes inside each phase
Left to right is order of work, not a calendar. Colour is the track; the lanes are inside the bar.
CI: all lanes green at once
= subtasks that must run in order, one lane per folder.
= one job in the GitHub Actions workflow; it is what proves the lane finished.
Only Phases 0 and 1 are planned today — later phases get their lanes when that phase is planned.
